author: Microsoft
description: Researchers from Providence, the University of Washington, and Microsoft developed GigaTIME, a publicly available AI model that generates spatial proteomic images at scale to help predict patient response to immunotherapy and expand access to advanced cancer research worldwide.
title: Scaling insights into immunotherapy with GigaTIME

author: Microsoft
description:
Manchester NHS clinicians are testing an AI tool that captures consultation notes automatically, helping doctors stay focused on patients. Built on Microsoft Dragon Copilot, the system reduces documentation time and could significantly expand patient capacity across the local trust.

Read the full story: https://aka.ms/AAyqj1j
title: How AI Is giving U.K. doctors more time with patients
